MEV Protected

Anti-MEV Protection

Caps slippage at 0.5%, blocks swaps with price impact above 5%, shortens the swap deadline to 2 minutes, and re-checks the price right before your transaction is sent.

Honest note: this reduces the risk of sandwich attacks and frontrunning, but it cannot guarantee 100% MEV-free swaps. Loop's Uniswap V2 has no private mempool, so your transaction is still publicly visible before it confirms.

Slippage Tolerance

Your transaction reverts automatically if the price moves more than this.

Your Orders

Split one total amount into equal orders on a fixed schedule, so your average entry price smooths out over time instead of depending on one moment.

How execution works — please read: there is no DCA contract or keeper bot on Loop Network yet. The schedule runs inside this page only: an order only happens while this page is open in your browser with your wallet connected, and your wallet asks you to confirm every single order — nothing is sent without your confirmation, and nothing runs automatically on-chain. If an order comes due while the page is closed or the wallet is disconnected, it waits until you are back. If an order fails or you reject it in your wallet, that slot is marked Failed in the history and the schedule moves on — it is not retried automatically. Plans live in this tab only and are gone when you close it.

Lock Token

Pick a token you hold, then set the amount and lock duration. The tokens move into the locker contract and can only be withdrawn once the unlock time arrives.

Or type your own lock duration in days (1–3650).

Token
Amount
Withdrawable from

Locking is final until the unlock time: the amount and date cannot be changed, moved earlier, or cancelled — by anyone, including the lock creator.

How It Works & Security

The locker is designed with no exploitable loopholes — its contract is deployed on-chain at 0xA4C46795Bc6116e0286ea13e1439622E9727B50f and works on these principles:

  • Only the owner can withdraw, and only after the unlock time is reached. There are no shortcuts.
  • No admin functions — no contract owner, no emergency function, nobody who can move or freeze someone else's lock.
  • The unlock time cannot be moved earlier and the locked amount cannot be changed once a lock is created.
  • Anti-reentrancy — withdrawals use the checks-effects-interactions pattern plus a reentrancy guard, and token transfers use SafeERC20.
  • All locks are recorded on-chain (Locked/Withdrawn events), so prospective buyers can verify the locked amount and unlock date of any token claimed to be locked themselves.

Farming is not active yet: no tokens can be staked, no rewards can be earned or claimed, and no APR is promised. Reward figures will only appear here after the contract is live and verified on-chain. Do not send tokens to any address claiming to be SakuraPad farming before the official contract is announced on this page.

How Farming Will Work

  1. 1Pick a farm. Once farms are live, each graduated token's farm will be listed below with its reward token and duration.
  2. 2Stake your tokens. Deposit the graduated token into the farming contract from this page — you keep full control until you confirm the transaction in your wallet.
  3. 3Earn & claim. Rewards build up while your tokens stay staked, and you claim them or withdraw your stake from this same page.

What You Can Stake

Farming is being prepared as direct token staking for tokens that have graduated to Uniswap V2 — not LP staking.

  • Graduated tokens only — the same tokens you can swap on the Swap page.
  • Graduation LP stays locked — it is permanently locked in the locker and cannot be moved or staked by anyone.
  • Your own LP is separate — LP you receive from the Liquidity page stays in your wallet and can be withdrawn there at any time; it is not part of farming.
